title: Head - Digital Sales
description: Job Description : Key Skills : We are now looking for candidates for Head Digital Sales position. - Candidate with Digital Sales and Marketing background. - Good networking and creating channels for activation and increasing the sales quota. - Create proposals for new leads, manage the sales pipeline, promotions and close the deals. - Strong understanding of customer and market dynamics and requirements, especially in B2C products and their business sales. - Able to operate in a fast-paced and changing market environment. - Proven leadership and ability to drive sales teams. - Strong leadership qualities with good communication, interpersonal & presentation skills. - Young, energetic and creative. Go getter attitude and strong focus driven.
